items.title: Strive buys 1,110 Bitcoin for $81.5M, holdings top 21K BTC; ASST shares surge 11%
items.summary: Strive’s Nasdaq-traded shares surged more than 11% as the Bitcoin treasury company said it paid an average of $73,409 per BTC, pushing its holdings to 21,356 Bitcoin.

items.title: Strive acquires 1,110 bitcoin for $81.5 million as total holdings reach 21,356 BTC
items.summary: Strive purchased 1,110 bitcoin for $81.5 million, raising its total holdings to 21,356 BTC as the seventh-largest public company holder.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine buys $81 million of ETH in largest weekly haul since early July
items.summary: The treasury firm stepped up its ETH buying as Tom Lee said the crypto’s 30% weekly rally could signal a larger move ahead.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $1.9B in strongest week since October 2025
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $1.92 billion last week, their strongest weekly inflow since October 2025, as Bitcoin briefly climbed above $78,000 on Friday.
